notices.title: November 9 Update — Stages
notices.body:
@tag patch
My Lord, here are the stage changes in the November 9 update.

## New stages
- Normal stages now open up to Chapter 50, with new titles and comics for Chapters 21-50.

## Hard stages
- Hard now has 5 stages per chapter (previously 4-15).
- Fully cleared chapters count all 5 as cleared; new stages give no first-clear rewards.
- Chapters in progress keep your cleared count from the first stage.
- Shards and enemy decks per stage have changed. Rewards already received stay.

## Card growth
- As announced, level-ups need more EXP, and star breakthroughs and skill upgrades need more shards.

notices.title: November 9 Update — Card Skill Adjustments
notices.body:
@tag patch
My Lord, here are the card skill adjustments in the November 9 update.

Skill upgrade counts and costs are unchanged; only the values at each upgrade tier have changed. Cards you have already upgraded use the new values right away. Values shown are for skill tier 6.

[buff n_treant skill 3>6] Root Armor: counter damage now rises by 1 every tier.
[buff a_archmage skill 3>6] Arcane Storm: opening damage now rises by 1 every tier.
[buff k_dwarfking skill 3>6] Golden Hammer: the deck-wide bonus now rises by 1 every tier.

- Fixed skill descriptions for Gnome Inventor, Miner Girl, Dwarf Cannoneer and Engineer Girl showing numbers different from their actual battle values. Battle results are unchanged.

Please update to the latest version. Thank you for playing.

notices.title: Advance Notice: Card Growth Rebalance
notices.body:
@tag info
My Lord, here is advance notice of an upcoming card growth rebalance.

Cards are currently reaching max level much faster than intended. We are adjusting growth so there is more to work toward over the long run.

## What's changing
- Card level-ups will require more EXP.
- Star breakthroughs and skill upgrades will require more character shards.

## When
- Planned for Monday, November 9.
- We will let you know if the schedule changes.

## Cards you have already raised
- Levels, stars and skill tiers you have already reached will stay as they are.
- Your shards and cards will not be removed.

Thank you for playing, and we look forward to many more battles with you.

notices.title: Resource Optimization & HD Data Download
notices.body:
Hello, this is Steelbanner.
To make installation lighter, we have greatly reduced the initial app size in this update.
To enjoy sharper card illustrations and battle effects, an additional in-game download is required.

## 1. How to Download
Title screen [Settings] → [Download HD Data]

## 2. Notes
- Background downloading is currently not available. Please choose "In Game" when selecting how to download.
- This may use mobile data, so we recommend using Wi-Fi.

We will keep improving to bring you a smoother, more polished experience.
Thank you.

notices.title: Nov 5 Update Changes (Auto Advance Ads Withdrawn · Balance Adjustments)
notices.body:
Hello, this is Steelbanner.
Here are some changes and details regarding the update announced today.

## 1. Ads for Auto Advance / Stage Repeat Withdrawn
We decided that limiting convenience features behind ads is not appropriate, and have fully withdrawn this plan.
Auto Advance and Stage Repeat remain free to use without ads, as before.

## 2. Stage Balance and Reward Adjustments
- Normal stage rewards: as previously announced, first-clear rewards change from 15 to 5.
- Difficulty: stage difficulty has been raised overall across sections.
- Hard mode rewards: by clearing Hard mode, you can earn rewards similar to before.

## 3. New Social Features
Friends and Guilds have been added so you can connect and cooperate with other players.

We sincerely apologize for the confusion during this update.
We will keep improving Steelbanner based on your feedback.
Thank you.

notices.title: Nov 5 (Thu) Update
notices.body:
@tag patch
My Lord, here is the news for the Nov 5 (Thu) 10:00 KST update.
Normal stages go on endlessly, so first-clear gems could pile up without limit.

## First-clear gems
- Normal: 15 → 5 per stage
- Hard: 10 per stage (new)
- Clear both and your total stays about the same.
- Gems you have already received will not be taken back.

## Auto Advance · Repeat
- Watch 1 ad to use them for 1 hour.
- Premium Pass: no ads needed.
- Not available on Hard stages.
---
We apologize for the sudden change.

notices.title: Nov 5 (Thu) Update 2 — Friends & Guilds
notices.body:
@tag info
My Lord, Friends and Guilds open with the Nov 5 (Thu) update.

## Friends
Open "Friends" on the left of Home.
- Follow each other to become friends.
- Send each friend a Friendship Point gift once a day.
- Spend points in the Friendship Shop for gold and card shards.
- Friendly Match: practice against a friend's main deck.

## Guilds
Open it below Patrol on the right of Home.
- Check in and donate to grow your guild and earn Guild Coins.
- Request and send card shards among members.
- Buy gold and card shards in the Guild Shop.
- Borrow a member's support card in Boss Battle and the Endless Tower.
---
We hope you enjoy playing together.

notices.title: Boss Raid Open — Iron Titan
notices.body:
@tag content
My Lord, the Boss Raid is open. Enter from “Modes” next to Sortie in the lobby, until Nov 16 (Mon) 05:00.

## This Boss
[card w_titan] A Machine Legendary not yet in summons.
- Escorts: Machine · Weakness: Nature (double damage)

## Boss Raid
- The boss's remaining HP carries over between fights. Bring it down over several fights.
- Defeat it for kill gold and escort card shards, then a stronger boss appears in the next round. Every 3rd round also grants Gems.
- Three fights a day, auto or by hand.
- When the period ends, the Endless Tower opens.

notices.title: Card Balance Update
notices.body:
@tag patch
My Lord, this update's card changes.

## Changes
[change d_darkknight] Gains +1/+1 whenever another ally takes damage.
[change d_demonknight atk 3>4 hp 5>1] Also deals the same damage to both sides of its target.
[change d_vampire] On deploy: gains +1/+1 if any ally is damaged.
[change d_plague] Last words: destroys the card that attacked and killed it. Not triggered by skill damage.
[change f_thornwitch] Defense: matches the attacker's Attack.
## Nerfs
[nerf u_vampirelord atk 3>2] On deploy: steals 1 HP from an adjacent ally and gains +1/+1.
[nerf k_lancer] When its attack kills an enemy, leftover damage hits an adjacent enemy.
---
- Fixed effects that didn't match some cards.
- Unified card description wording.
- The back button now closes popups.

Please update the app from the store.

notices.title: Steelbanner Has Launched
notices.body:
@tag info
My Lord, thank you for waiting. Today the castle gates are open.

Summon cards, build your deck, and face your foes across three lanes.
A card that has been played won't return that match, so choose your order wisely.

## Launch Gift
- 1,000 gems have been sent to your mailbox. (Claim within a month)
- Check in daily to receive 300 gems on day 7.

## A Request from Your Steward
- Please report any issues or bugs via "Contact Support" in the title settings.
- For payment inquiries, include the UID shown in your profile so we can help faster.

I will keep coming back with new cards and news.
